verdict.rationale: llama.cpp ships its own first-party command-line tools: `llama cli` runs models pulled straight from Hugging Face and supports VLM sessions, and `llama serve` starts a server. Distribution channels include pre-built release binaries and Winget, and a community user confirms hands-on use of the CLI for multimodal chat. missing for 10: detailed CLI reference documentation (flags/subcommands) in the evidence, evidence of agent-oriented or scripted (non-interactive, machine-readable output) CLI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: using llama-mtmd-cli with quantized multimodal models like Gemma-3
